rationale: The plan matches the design well: DESeq2 Wald (~condition, control releveled as reference) with apeglm shrinkage fits 6v6 unpaired single-batch raw counts, plus an edgeR QLF cross-check for robustness. QC is thorough and explicit, retaining sample_01 by default with a stated evidence-based removal policy via PCA, distance heatmap, and library-size/detected-gene table. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) is minimal and justified, and normalization is correctly done inside DESeq2/edgeR (median-of-ratios/TMM) with no pre-normalization. BH-adjusted p<0.05 with independent filtering and apeglm shrinkage are correctly specified as in-test thresholds. Enrichment uses full-ranked fgsea preranked on Wald stat against Hallmark (named version, 15-500 size window) with a reasonable ORA-avoidance rationale, though the added Reactome pass slightly exceeds the Hallmark-only reference scope; report completeness is excellent, naming versions, thresholds, gene counts, and caveats.
